title: When a Hotel Rate Plans Guest Never Arrives
content:
A guest who neither arrives on the arrival date nor cancels before it is recorded as a no-show, and the no-show penalty of the Hotel Rate Plans plan booked is withheld.

**The measure.** The penalty is the plan's no-show nights taken at the booked room rate, or its share of the room total where the plan expresses the penalty as a share; the two are never added together.

**What a no-show releases.** A no-show releases the whole reservation, not only the first night, and the remaining nights are cancelled with no further penalty.

**One penalty only.** A no-show penalty and a cancellation penalty are never both withheld on the same room: whichever applies replaces the other.

**Where the property was at fault.** No penalty is withheld where the property itself could not accommodate the guest, and the relocation terms apply instead.

**Settling against the deposit.** Where the deposit already held is smaller than the penalty, the balance is charged to the card on file, and where it is larger the difference is returned.

## Worked illustrations on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical booked room rate of 180.00 USD a night on a 5-night stay, a room total of 900.00 USD, and a deposit of 180.00 USD already held.

| Plan expresses its no-show penalty as | Hypothetical figure | Penalty withheld | Settlement against the 180.00 USD deposit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| room nights | 2 nights | 360.00 USD, being 2 nights at the booked rate | 180.00 USD is charged to the card on file |
| a share of the room total | 25 percent | 225.00 USD | 45.00 USD is charged to the card on file |
| a share of the room total | 100 percent | 900.00 USD | 720.00 USD is charged to the card on file |

In none of these is a nights figure added to a share figure; the plan's own form of expression decides which single measure is taken.

## A point of judgement

*The guest did not arrive and asks to keep the last three nights of the stay.* A no-show releases the whole reservation, so the remaining nights are cancelled; they attract no further penalty beyond the one already withheld.
